# Yash Maheshwari

> ML researcher (high school, Mountain View, California, Class of 2027) working on efficient small language models, healthcare AI agent benchmarks, and student-led AI policy. Research intern at Stanford's Shah Lab (Stanford Medicine) and Lemons Lab (Stanford Graduate School of Education).

## Research
- **Halved CLM Exposure Mitigates Late-Training Degradation in Small Recurrent Language Models** (published, Proceedings of the Second BabyLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026, ACL, pp. 1-14; sole author; DOI 10.18653/2026.babylm-main.1; https://aclanthology.org/2026.babylm-main.1/): halving how often causal language modeling updates the weights mitigates late-training BLiMP degradation in small RWKV-7 (27.4M-parameter) recurrent models trained locally with MLX. Official BabyLM 2026 pipeline: 68.70% BLiMP, above the GPT-2 baseline (65.23%, 98.4M parameters) at about 28% as many parameters. Page: https://research.yash-maheshwari.com/papers/babylm-2026
- **Below One Bit: Training Route and Budget Shape Robustness Under On-Device Storage Constraints** (accepted, poster, NeurIPS 2026 ODI Workshop; sole author): with the same number of tokens trained in the format, natively trained sub-1-bit models degrade less on corrupted Python code than post-training-quantized and fine-tuned models in every setting and seed, but remain worse in absolute terms; the token budget sets the size and sign of the gap. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=uGyEuoSW6N Page: https://research.yash-maheshwari.com/papers/odi-2026
- **HealthAdminBench V2** (in development, Stanford Shah Lab with Kinetic Systems): benchmark of LLM agents on healthcare administrative work (prior authorizations, denial appeals, DME orders) in a realistic Epic EHR environment on the Harbor framework.
- **Training and comparison of fine-tuned small language models as math tutoring assistants** (accepted, in press, Journal of Emerging Investigators; first author, with Rinky Gupta): fine-tuned Llama tutors at 1B, 3B and 8B parameters; parameter count mattered more than training epochs; the 8B model reached 93.65% step accuracy. Page: https://research.yash-maheshwari.com/papers/jei-2026
- **Trace the Ace $50K Challenge (2026)**: placed 12th of 530 teams competing solo, predicting student quiz outcomes from tutoring transcripts.
- **Patents (filed 2025)**: Hierarchical Aggregation Tree for MCP Server Selection and Execution (non-provisional, sole inventor); Predictive Compliance for AI Agents (provisional, co-inventor with Aisera).

## Experience
- Research Intern, Shah Lab, Stanford Medicine (Prof. Nigam Shah), Aug 2026-present; AI Research Contractor, Kinetic Systems, Jul-Aug 2026.
- Research Intern, Lemons Lab, Stanford GSE (Prof. Chris Lemons), Jun 2025-present: Kai AI reading tutor (1,200+ students, 50+ teachers, 10+ districts); PAWS handwriting iPad app.
- AI Engineering Intern, Aisera, Jun-Aug 2025: MCP servers for Salesforce, Clari and Slack; MCP bridge for HTTP and SSE.
- Executive Board Member, MVHS Principal's Tech Internship, Sep 2024-present.
